summary: Attempt 2 of BG-KV2-501-C6 (r1 stopped at stop condition 1 pre-implementation; the owner amendment recorded in spec 5.10 resolves the conflict: the per-face window rides ON the closed whole-sweep value, so both immovable landed assertions hold unchanged). The enum boundary now carries the whole-sweep surface type: new `constructive::SpineFrameSweep` (`vendor/truck/truck-geometry/src/constructive/sweep_surface.rs`) stores the landed `SpineFrameRecipe` ONCE over the canonical `Box<Curve>` spine carrier (the closed Curve/Surface enums are Clone+Serialize, which the constructive Spine enum's Box<dyn SpineCurve> payload forbids; compiler-verified at r1), the realized window domain [s0,s1]x[v0,v1] as part of the closed value (the r1 volume evidence - windowed -1.0 vs whole-ring -3.0 on the unit prism - is why the window stays on the closed value), and the sweep-level `Matrix4` placement. `canonical.rs`'s `Surface::SpineFrameSurface` variant payload switches from the windowed realization decorator `SpineFrameSurface<Box<Curve>>` to `SpineFrameSweep`; the variant NAME is unchanged. The decorator layer keeps the windowed realization decorator (constructed through the same shared window validation `decorators::validate_surface_window`, reused verbatim by both constructors), and the landed B-rep constructor's per-face windowed realizations are preserved: `spine_sweep` stores one whole-sweep closed value per side face over exactly that face's edge window with the identity placement the constructor always set (stop condition 2's guard: no two faces of one sweep carry different transforms). Numeric realization stays in the landed evaluator path (the sweep forwards to the shared spine_frame evaluation helpers; no surface math re-derived in the constructive module). Section 3's typed-refusal carry is landed: `refuse` in `truck-modeling/src/spine_sweep.rs` is now an explicit per-variant match over every `ConstructError` (no catch-all arm) mapping to the honest envelope case - `EnvelopeCase::ConstructRefused`, the constructive-realization envelope (CG-000 mapping A row 1); the previous code dropped the detail onto `NonCanonicalCarrier`. Every immovable constraint passes UNCHANGED: truck-modeling `spine_sweep_conformance.rs::convex_prism_volume_matches_analytic` (unit prism volume 1.0, measured again with the real conformance formula) and truck-geometry `spine_frame_brep.rs` (incl. `surface_variant_forwarding_all_landed_methods`, whose enum-carried window assertions now hold on the sweep payload). Pre-existing, environment-caused failures unrelated to this diff were confirmed present at the base commit (e3305c2) by running them in a base worktree: truck-stepio lib `geom_impls::builder`, truck-shapeops lib `healing::tests::step_import`, truck-shapeops `fillet::complex_surface`, and the truck-stepio data-driven integration tests that read the not-vendored `vendor/truck/resources/step` directory.

measured_counts.unit_prism_volume: 1.0 (windowed per-face sweeps; the r1 whole-ring 3.0 reading is gone)
measured_counts.side_faces_of_unit_prism: 4 sweep faces each over exactly one edge window + 2 plane caps; every sweep placement identity

deviations.derivation: Spec 5.10's literal struct would store `spine: Spine` (Ph | General(Box<dyn SpineCurve>)); the closed Surface enum and every truck topology S: Clone/Serialize path force the stored recipe's spine onto the canonical Box<Curve> carrier (the constructive Spine enum is not Clone/Serialize - compiler-verified at r1 and recorded in the owner amendment). The packet's Section 1 as amended stores `SpineFrameRecipe<Box<Curve>, ProfileLaw, FrameLaw>`; the sweep_surface module doc and canonical.rs variant doc record this.

r1's CONVEX_PRISM_VOLUME_BREAKS_UNDER_WHOLE_SWEEP and PINNED_WINDOW_SEMANTICS_ON_ENUM_PAYLOAD deviations are RESOLVED by the owner amendment: the sweep carries its realized window [s0,s1]x[v0,v1] as part of the closed value (plus the sweep-level placement), so the landed B-rep constructor keeps one per-face windowed sweep per side face and convex_prism_volume_matches_analytic stays at 1.0. Section 2's 'window views derive, never store' is read (per the amendment) as: the enum no longer stores the windowed REALIZATION DECORATOR; the realization view is derived from the closed value over the shared validation.

The typed-refusal carry (Section 3): every ConstructError variant now maps to Refusal::UnsupportedEnvelope(EnvelopeCase::ConstructRefused), the honest constructive-realization envelope of mapping A row 1 (the previous code dropped the detail onto NonCanonicalCarrier). The per-variant match has no catch-all arm, so a new ConstructError variant stops the build for an explicit decision; stop condition 3 never fired because every landed variant has an honest envelope case.
